The proposed answer of 735 matches the value I recall as the official answer to this problem (AIME 2025 II). I did not re-derive the full count, so this rests partly on that recollection.

I did check two things:
- The arithmetic at the end is consistent: N = 5·3¹¹ = 885735, which leaves remainder 735 mod 1000.
- N is about 5 times the heuristic count 729³/3⁷ = 177147, which is plausible given the strong structure of cubes modulo powers of 3.

VERDICT: ACCEPT
